name: BSP_SubmarineUnit_StepCrushDepthDamage
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc2_submarine_model, read-only analysis. __thiscall(unit, float dt), RET 4, body 008551C0-0085524F, called only from 0085592B in 00855420. Reconstructed as a pure rule returning the damage and the report flag instead of calling vtable[1ACh] and 00977370. The non-obvious parts: the accumulator +1284h is stored back before the once-a-second test so the field carries the un-pulsed remainder; the pose refresh is inside the branch so the hull Y is read only on a pulse; the damage scales with the accumulated interval and not the frame dt; and the depth limit is the global Submarine.SubmarineDamageDepth (installed 70.0) rather than any class key, so every submarine crushes at the same depth and a class whose SwimDepth3 is shallower than 70 never crushes under its own commands.
